name: Apartment block
description: Four-storey apartment block, 18 x 13 m: a grey-rendered ground floor with a glazed double entrance under a steel canopy, brick-slip upper floors with white-rendered centre bays, concrete balconies with glass balustrades for every flat, a parapet roof with a lift overrun and plant. Enterable: an entrance lobby and two ground-floor flats; two flats per upper floor (living room and bedroom each), off a central stair hall corridor with two stair cores.

core A: level 2 up to the half landing
